required_bodies: Baseline actual shared activity::compute and distinct pressure body only if emitted/consumed
Candidate actual shared Activity compute, actual consumed scalar/clipped pressure bodies or clones
Candidate actual FULL implementation/native transport caller only where necessary to establish real bool route/ABI; source proof covers every root/ordinary/Q caller
scope.capture_policy: Follow actual call addresses from consumed owners; capture each complete body once. Inlined pressure is inspected inside enclosing compute; absence of a distinct symbol is not a collection error. Do not capture every demangled match or all recursive search bodies. Relevant missing/unclassifiable target beyond the finite scope requires stop/report.
scope.failure_limit_or_unclassifiable_relevant: Preserve output and actual failure, stop before correction or scope expansion.

required_gate: Confirm actual Activity uses one shared scoring body with runtime bool selecting only pressure tail; do not infer common ownership from source names or demangling. Public scalar/fresh/observed wrappers remain false; no giant const-bool duplicated Activity/full body.

Follow actual native full_for_search/full_impl and Activity bool argument from real caller/callee addresses, distinguishing existing result buffer and new bool register/stack/spill lifetime. Source proof covers ALL ordinary/root/Q sparse/refresh routes; capture only enough actual consumed owners to establish lowering, no gratuitous whole-search captures.

In true slider-pressure path, selected-target loop must have no per-target mailbox load/color/type decoding/coordinate bounds or scalar offset termination. Required marks/static PRESSURE_VALUES lookup/addition remain. Old scalar fallback and literal knight path must remain usable.

Identify borrowed existing ray/polarity geometry, no ray-row copy, allocation, reconstructed geometry or new stored view. At most selected family setup; inspect no-slider early path before plane/clipping work and guard empty bit scans. Static source guard is not proof of physical setup erasure.

Price actual occupancy/color decode, nearest occupied selection, outward-ray clipping, endpoint inclusion/exclusion, family union, lsb iteration and mark addressing. Keep diagonal 0xcc and orthogonal 0xf0 numeric ownership distinct; do not combine wrong-family marks.

Compare complete consumed caller/callee code bytes, reservations/saves, locals/spills/outgoing arguments, calls and bool continuation. Include zero/sparse families, false fallback and unchanged knight work. No frame-only gain, instruction/copy neutrality or dynamic frequency/speed claim.

Reject if targeted per-target classification remains or relocates equivalently, authority is inferred from map/check status, setup becomes eager for inactive families, or consumed ownership cannot be classified within caps. Other code/frame/call risks are explicit for parent judgment.

tool_execution_limits.after_release_only: Resolve known /usr/bin tools and record actual identities; capture nm/readelf metadata and finite objdump address ranges; retain commands/stdout/stderr/actual outer terminal and before/after image/source/compiler/tool pins.
